# Agent Configuration

This file configures how agent skills interact with this repository.

### Domain docs

Single-context layout with `CONTEXT.md` at the repo root and ADRs in `docs/adr/`. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.

## Working on this repo

### Commands

| Task | Command |
|------|---------|
| Start the dev server | `pnpm dev` |
| Typecheck + bundle | `pnpm build` |
| Run tests | `pnpm test` |
| Lint | `npx projen eslint` |
| Refresh datasets (fetch + prepare) | `pnpm run data` |

### Generated files (projen)

This project is managed with projen. Files marked "Generated by projen" (`package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `.gitignore`, `.eslintrc.json`, `.github/workflows/*`, `.projen/*`) are overwritten by `pnpm exec projen`. To change them, edit `.projenrc.ts` and run `pnpm exec projen` — never edit them directly. Everything else (`AGENTS.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, `src/`, `scripts/`, `data/`, `docs/`) is hand-written.

### Conventions

- Branches: `feat/<name>`, `fix/<name>`, `chore/<name>`.
- Read `CONTEXT.md` first for domain terminology, architecture and file layout.
